description: First converted statistics pass. Adds Hypertext d20-compatible creature stat blocks for the Beasts of the Abyss entry instead of leaving the mechanics as a legacy placeholder.

entries.title: Beasts of the Abyss
entries.summary: A family of colossal predators, parasites, and warped hunters reported in the lightless reaches below the clouds, now converted into Hypertext d20-compatible creature statistics.
body: The Abyss is not merely empty darkness below the skylands. It is an ecological and supernatural pressure zone where predators, parasites, void-touched hunters, and corrupted survival forms wait for falling ships, lost crews, and reckless explorers.

Source accounts name the ship-swallowing [[abyssal-maw|Abyssal Maw]], the storm-making [[shadowwing-leviathan|Shadowwing Leviathan]], regenerative [[sable-tendrils|Sable Tendrils]], the web-spinning [[blackclaw|Blackclaw]], the phasing [[nightmare-hound|Nightmare Hound]], and mounted [[gloomrider|Gloomriders]].

The statistics below are converted Hypertext d20-compatible working stat blocks derived from the source descriptions. They are no longer placeholders. They are meant to be playable, searchable, and usable by encounter, sky-ecology, and airship-threat tools.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: The source text describes major abilities, dangers, and behavior rather than a unified completed d20 stat framework. This pass converts those descriptions into Hypertext d20-compatible statistics using d20-style creature entries, saving throws, armor classes, hit dice, attacks, special attacks, qualities, skills, feats, environment, organization, treasure, and challenge rating.

Values are intentionally high because these creatures threaten airships and whole crews rather than only single ground-level adventurers. Later balancing passes can tune CR, hit dice, and save DCs after playtesting.

statBlocks.title: Abyssal Maw
speed: Abyssal drift 30 ft. while in void currents
specialAttacks: Swallow Whole (Ex): If the Abyssal Maw begins its turn grappling a Huge or smaller creature, ship section, or exposed crew cluster, it may attempt a grapple check to swallow. Swallowed creatures take 4d8+16 bludgeoning damage plus 4d8 acid damage each round. Escape requires dealing 60 slashing or piercing damage to the interior AC 18 before the wound seals.

Ship-Swallowing Maw (Ex): Against vessels, the Maw attacks a ship zone instead of a creature. On a successful bite against a disabled, immobilized, or grappled ship, it deals 8d10 structural damage and may engulf a section at the GM's discretion.

Void Pull (Su): 300-ft. radius gravity well; flying creatures and vessels must succeed on a DC 34 Reflex save or be pulled 60 ft. toward the Maw. Airships may substitute a piloting or control check at the same DC. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Abyssal Corruption (Su): Magical items, exposed mechanisms, and airship systems within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 31 Fortitude save or Engineering/Arcana maintenance check each minute or become degraded. Degraded systems take a -2 penalty to relevant checks; three failed checks disable the system until repaired.
specialQualities: Abyssal camouflage (+20 Hide in full darkness while motionless)
skills: Hide -18 (+2 in darkness, +22 motionless in abyssal dark)
statBlocks.environment: Deep Abyss, lowest void currents, abyssal pits
statBlocks.treasure: Incidental; swallowed wreckage, corroded cargo, and partially digested ship relics
tactics: Waits motionless until a ship or creature comes within gravity-well range.
Uses Void Pull to drag prey into bite reach, then corrupts ship systems before swallowing or crushing sections.
Rarely pursues outside its abyssal hunting zone unless drawn by a large magical engine or damaged airship core.
conversionNotes: Converted from source abilities: Swallow Whole, Void Pull, and Abyssal Corruption.
Designed as an airship-scale apex hazard rather than a routine wandering monster.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Beasts of the Abyss / The Abyssal Maw

statBlocks.title: Shadowwing Leviathan
speed: Abyssal shadow glide 300 ft. in full darkness
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +32 melee (4d8+18), 2 wing buffets +30 melee (2d8+9), and tail slap +30 melee (4d6+9)
specialAttacks: Dark Gale (Su): 180-ft. cone of abyssal wind; creatures must succeed on a DC 31 Reflex save or take 8d6 cold damage, be pushed 60 ft., and be knocked prone. Airships struck by the gale must succeed on a DC 31 control check or be blown off-course and take 6d10 structural damage.

Void Screech (Su): 300-ft. spread, once every 1d4 rounds; living creatures must succeed on a DC 30 Will save or be stunned for 1 round and shaken for 1d6 rounds. A successful save negates the stun and halves the shaken duration.

Shadow Ambush (Ex): In areas of darkness, fog, or abyssal shadow, the Leviathan may make a Hide check even while observed and gains +2d6 damage on the first attack against a target that failed to detect it.
statBlocks.environment: Middle to Deep Abyss, storm-dark void layers
statBlocks.treasure: None, though lairs may contain wreckage carried by abyss winds
tactics: Approaches under cover of shadow before using Void Screech to disable crews.
Uses Dark Gale to force airships into cliffs, gravity wells, or deeper abyssal layers.
Avoids prolonged melee with heavily armed vessels unless the crew is already stunned or off-course.
conversionNotes: Converted from source abilities: Dark Gale, Void Screech, and Abyssal Flight.
Built as a mobile abyssal hunter that attacks navigation and crew control before hull integrity.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Beasts of the Abyss / Shadowwing Leviathan

statBlocks.title: Sable Tendrils
speed: Fly 30 ft. (poor) while anchored to abyssal surfaces
statBlocks.fullAttack: 6 tendrils +27 melee (2d8+15 plus grab) and 6 mouths +25 melee (1d8+7 plus poison)
specialAttacks: Grasp of the Abyss (Ex): A Sable Tendril that hits with a tendril attack may attempt to start a grapple without provoking. Grappled targets take 2d8+15 constriction damage each round and may be dragged 30 ft. downward or toward an abyssal surface.

Airship Snare (Ex): Against a ship, three or more successful tendril hits in the same round force a DC 29 control check. Failure entangles the ship zone, reduces speed by half, and deals 4d10 structural damage each round until the tendrils are severed.
Poisonous Kiss (Ex): Mouth attack; Fortitude DC 28; initial effect paralysis for 1d4 rounds, secondary effect 1d6 Dexterity damage. The save DC is Constitution-based.
Severed Tendril Assault (Ex): A severed tendril continues to attack for 1d4 rounds unless destroyed by fire, radiant energy, or consecrated magic.
statBlocks.environment: Abyss walls, void crevasses, drifting wreck fields
statBlocks.organization: Solitary growth, cluster (2-4), or colony (5-12 tendril masses)
statBlocks.treasure: Incidental; tangled wreckage, trapped cargo, and the remains of prior victims
tactics: Attacks from outside normal sightlines and begins by snaring sails, rudders, exposed crew, or engine struts.
Regenerates unless crews spend actions burning or consecrating severed tendrils.
Attempts to drag prey downward rather than fighting fairly.
conversionNotes: Converted from source abilities: Grasp of the Abyss, Poisonous Kiss, and Regeneration.
Designed as a persistent airship-control and hazard creature.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Beasts of the Abyss / Sable Tendrils

statBlocks.title: Blackclaw
speed: Leap 100 ft. horizontal or 50 ft. vertical
statBlocks.fullAttack: 6 claws +34 melee (4d6+16 plus poison) and bite +32 melee (4d8+8)
specialAttacks: Web of the Void (Su): 120-ft. ranged touch or 60-ft. burst webbing; Reflex DC 29 negates. Entangled targets are anchored, take a -4 penalty to Dexterity, and must succeed on a DC 34 Strength check or DC 30 Escape Artist check to break free. Airship zones caught in the web lose maneuverability and take a -6 penalty on control checks.

Energy-Draining Web (Su): Creatures or ship systems trapped in Web of the Void take 2d6 negative energy damage each round. Magical engines or devices must succeed on a DC 27 caster level, Arcana, or Engineering check each round or become suppressed for 1 round.

Claws of Fate (Ex): On a successful claw hit against metal, hull plating, or an unattended object, the Blackclaw ignores the first 10 points of hardness. A leaping full-weight strike deals double claw damage to a ship zone.
Abyssal Poison (Ex): Claw or bite; Fortitude DC 30; initial effect paralysis for 1d6 rounds and hallucinations for 1 minute; secondary effect 2d6 Constitution damage.
statBlocks.environment: Dense Abyss, webbed ruins, darkness below trade routes
statBlocks.treasure: Half standard; trapped cargo, dissolved wrecks, and webbed remains
tactics: Fires Web of the Void first, then leaps onto immobilized vessels.
Targets sails, rudders, elemental rings, and exposed deck crews before cracking the hull.
Uses poison against officers, pilots, and repair crews to prevent recovery.
conversionNotes: Converted from source abilities: Web of the Void, Claws of Fate, and Abyssal Poison.
Designed as a ship-disabler and boarding-scale abyss predator.

statBlocks.title: Nightmare Hound
speed: Phase step 120 ft. as supernatural movement in darkness
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +28 melee (3d8+18 plus soul devour) and 2 claws +26 melee (2d6+9)
specialAttacks: Howl of the Void (Su): 240-ft. spread; Will DC 26 negates. Creatures that fail are confused for 1d4 rounds and shaken for 1 minute. Creatures that fail by 5 or more are instead panicked for 1d4 rounds before becoming shaken.

Phantasmal Pursuit (Su): Once per round as a move action, the Nightmare Hound may teleport up to 120 ft. between areas of dim light or darkness, but must end adjacent to a creature it has tracked, heard, or scented within the last minute.
Soul Devour (Su): Bite attack; Fortitude DC 25 negates. On a failed save, the target gains one negative level and cannot benefit from natural healing for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Relentless Quarry (Su): Once the hound damages a target, it gains a +10 insight bonus on Survival checks to track that target across mundane terrain, airship decks, and abyssal distortions for 24 hours.
specialQualities: Incorporeal flicker 20% miss chance in dim light
Resistance to cold 20 and negative energy 20
statBlocks.environment: Abyssal hunting routes, wreck shadows, void-choked passes
tactics: Begins with Howl of the Void from beyond easy visibility.
Uses Phantasmal Pursuit to bypass barricades, ship railings, and defensive formations.
Focuses on one target until Soul Devour weakens or drops the quarry.
conversionNotes: Converted from source abilities: Howl of the Void, Phantasmal Pursuit, and Soul Devour.
Designed as a psychic pursuit predator rather than a brute-force hull destroyer.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Beasts of the Abyss / Nightmare Hound

statBlocks.title: Gloomrider
statBlocks.attack: Cursed composite longbow +22 ranged (2d6+8 plus curse) or lance +22 melee (2d6+10)
statBlocks.fullAttack: Cursed composite longbow +22/+17/+12/+7 ranged (2d6+8 plus curse) or lance +22/+17/+12/+7 melee (2d6+10)
specialAttacks: Cursed Arrow (Su): A creature damaged by a Gloomrider's arrow must succeed on a DC 23 Will save or become cursed for 24 hours. While cursed, the target takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks and must succeed on a DC 23 Fortitude save each hour or take 1d4 Constitution damage.

Dark Steed's Charge (Su): Mounted charge; line 120 ft. Airborne creatures and exposed deck crews in the path must succeed on a DC 24 Reflex save or take 6d6 bludgeoning damage plus 4d6 negative energy damage and be knocked prone. Airships struck by the charge must succeed on a DC 24 control check or be forced 60 ft. off-course.

Hunter's Mark (Su): As a swift action, the Gloomrider marks one creature or ship it can see. It gains a +4 bonus on attack rolls, Survival checks, and damage rolls against the marked target for 1 hour.
specialQualities: Resistance to cold 10 and negative energy 10
statBlocks.environment: Abyssal routes, shadowed skies, wreck approaches
statBlocks.organization: Solitary, hunting pair, or flight (3-8 plus dark steeds)
statBlocks.treasure: Standard; cursed arrows, shadow gear, trophies, and stolen signal gear
tactics: Marks targets before emerging from shadow cover.
Uses cursed arrows to soften pilots, officers, and spellcasters before ordering a dark steed charge.
Withdraws into darkness and returns after the curse has weakened the prey.
conversionNotes: Converted from source abilities: Shadow Cloak, Cursed Arrow, and Dark Steed's Charge.
The dark steed is treated as part of the Gloomrider encounter package for this stat block; later passes may split it into a separate mount stat block.
